title: Its Own Pawn, Its Own Cage
setup: Black's king sits in the corner behind its own pawn on h7, and your king on f7 stands close by.
hint: Your king already covers g7 and g8. The rook only has to reach the back rank.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Ra8#}} checks along the back rank. Your king on f7 covers g7 and g8, Black's own pawn fills h7, and nothing can capture the rook or block the check.

In a king and rook ending, your king boxes the enemy king in and the rook gives the check.
